rules.title: Boston rent stabilization home rule petition (H.3744, 193rd session)
rules.requirement: This proposal never became law. A 2023–2024 home rule petition would have let Boston adopt rent stabilization, but it was sent to a study order and died when the session ended, so it does not limit rent increases in Boston.
rules.coverage_conditions: Would have authorized the City of Boston to implement rent stabilization. The bill text is not in this document, so the coverage details are unknown.
rules.quoted_span: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.conflict_note: Massachusetts state law (the 1994 rent control ban, M.G.L. c. 40P) forbids local rent control, which is why Boston needed a special act from the Legislature. On 9/9/2024 the bill was sent to a study order (H5035), and it died at the end of the 193rd session. This document does not cover that state ban.

rules.title: Boston tenant eviction protections home rule petition (H.3744, 193rd session)
rules.requirement: This proposal never became law. The petition would have let Boston adopt tenant eviction protections, but it was sent to a study order and died when the 2023–2024 session ended.
rules.coverage_conditions: Would have authorized the City of Boston to implement tenant eviction protections. The bill text is not in this document, so the details are unknown.
rules.quoted_span: that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections

notes: The source page shows only the bill's history, not its text, so the details of the proposed rent stabilization and eviction protections (caps, exemptions, which buildings it covers) can't be pulled from it. Both records are marked failed for two reasons. First, on 9/9/2024 the bill 'Accompanied a study order, see H5035'. Second, the 193rd session (2023-2024) ended without the bill being enacted. A later Boston petition in the 194th session, if one exists, would need to be checked on its own. This document says nothing about the state ban on rent control (M.G.L. c. 40P), so no state record was created for it.
